messages.helpIntro: Welcome to Cryptic 26. Learn the law before you walk the path:
messages.helpGettingStarted:
• Use /createteam <name> to create a team in this channel
• Others can join with /jointeam
• Teams can have up to {{maxTeamSize}} members
messages.helpPlaying:
• Use /hunt to see your current challenge
• Submit answers with /answer <solution>
• Request a staff hint with /hint <message> (one per level, 25% penalty)
• Check team info with /teaminfo
messages.helpScoring:
• Teams earn points for correct answers
• First team to solve gets 🩸 **FIRST BLOOD** (and a small tiebreaker bonus)
• Check rankings with /leaderboard
• View completed levels with /previous
messages.helpTeamCommands:
• /teaminfo - View team details
• /jointeam - Join the team in this channel
• /firstblood - See first blood achievements
